subject: Your sister's 2AM text
preview_text: One person in your life is ignoring a red flag you already see. Show them what you know.
body_paragraphs: You know that feeling when someone you care about sends you a screenshot of a conversation, and your gut screams "this is bad" but you don't have the words to explain why? That happened to me last week with my cousin. She sent me a text from her boyfriend that looked innocent on the surface, but I felt that twist in my stomach.

I opened Red Flag Scanner AI, pasted the screenshot, and within seconds it flagged three red patterns: gaslighting, emotional invalidation, and a toxicity score of 78%. I didn't have to be the bad guy or ruin a relationship—I just showed her the app. She scanned the rest of their chats, saw the pattern, and finally had the clarity to walk away.

You already have this power in your pocket. The Share Scan feature lets you send a full toxicity breakdown to anyone you love—anonymously. They don't even know you're behind it. Just open the app, scan the conversation you've been worrying about, and hit the share button. It's like giving them a truth serum without the awkward conversation.

Open Red Flag Scanner AI right now and scan the last text from that one person you've been worried about. Then hit share. You might be the reason they finally see clearly. P.S. The recipient will only see the results, not your name—so there's zero risk to your relationship.
